rows.text: zeroes qwords `+0`, `+8` and `+0x10` of `rdx`; calls `001FDF10` + 0x2C with (`rdx+0x18`, `rcx+0xF8`, the incoming `r8` and `r9`, a zero dword as the fifth (stack) argument); then calls `001FDF10` + 0x42 with (`rdx`, qword `+0xE0` of `rcx`, qword `+0xE8` of `rcx`) and returns `rdx`

notes: 001FDF10: other direct site `001B6230` + 0x24. r8 and r9 are not written before the + 0x2C call, so they pass through from the caller (whether the callee reads them is not visible here).
